# IntraMed Solution
> Medical devices supplier and distributor in Pakistan, based in Lahore. Sterile, single-use cardiology, urology, gastroenterology and vascular devices for hospitals and clinics nationwide (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta).
